subject.title: Anthropic replay fails with "Invalid signature in thinking block" for thinking-enabled sessions after tool loops (no compaction)

question: Should the no-compaction Anthropic replay fix cover Fable5 completed-turn thinking replay, or should Fable5 invalid-signature poisoning stay in a separate recovery/sanitizer path?
rationale: The open closing PR is proof-backed for the focused native replay policy but explicitly preserves Fable5 full replay, while the newest production comment reports the same permanent invalid-signature failure on Fable5.

options.title: Split Fable5 recovery from the focused PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 focused on the non-Fable5 create-side fix and track Fable5 interrupted-turn poisoning through the recovery/sanitizer issue path before closing this issue.

options.title: Expand the closing PR to cover Fable5
options.body: Require the closing PR to change Fable5 completed-turn replay policy too, with explicit provider-contract proof and upgrade-risk review.

options.title: Keep Fable5 full replay unchanged
options.body: Accept that Fable5 invalid-signature poisoning is a separate known limitation and close this issue only for the non-Fable5 no-compaction path after the PR merges.

recommendation.title: Split Fable5 recovery from the focused PR
recommendation.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 focused on the non-Fable5 create-side fix and track Fable5 interrupted-turn poisoning through the recovery/sanitizer issue path before closing this issue.
